long_path_retry.cause: Dedicated temporary parent made test health.sock paths 101-102 bytes; runtime safety maximum is 100 bytes. No application/test source modification needed.

disk_retry.reason: Sequential database commits waited on disk journal; only 1 percent completed during a 4m34s run, insufficient pace for the complete 4581-case gate within its 40-minute watchdog.
disk_retry.decision: Interrupt only owned pytest and rerun unchanged full gate using dedicated ephemeral 8GiB tmpfs parent; snapshot reserve remains on disk.
disk_retry.interrupt_result: pytest exited 1 after an interruption-time internal StashKey error; no application test failure was observed before SIGINT.

storage_retry.result: harness storage exhausted; interrupted after ENOSPC

diagnosis.reason: Test tmpfs exhausted during full suite, no application diagnosis inferred from cascading write failures.
diagnosis.response: Interrupt owned pytest; keep logs; rerun full gate on explicitly selected disk-backed scratch without reducing snapshot reserve.

storage_retry.resolution: Explicit validated dedicated pytest temp parent; complete suite and disk-backed snapshot storage reserve unchanged.

earlier_attempt.reason: 4571-case suite and retained idle previews exceeded the recorded idle-host workload; same complete gate restarted with a 40-minute bounded pytest watchdog. No checks skipped.

release.skip_policy: Repository standard non-root RELEASE gate; no tests deselected. Optional image, acquisition, root-owned transition, and LAN jobs retain their existing guards.
release.resource_policy: All acceptance workers closed before gate. No concurrent live probes/build/acquisition; user-required existing previews kept available and idle.
